Daughters watch father's funeral via video call, send money

Three daughters did not attend their father's funeral in Sonipat, Haryana, instead watching the ceremony via video call. The daughters sent ₹5,100 for cremation expenses. One daughter inquired if all rituals were performed correctly and requested a video recording. The father, Shivcharan, a former cloth merchant, resided in an old-age home. Coverage also noted that the daughters had not attended their mother's funeral previously.
